# Plugins and widgets

Dictionary tools for people who build websites.

## [A search box for your website »](https://www.teanglann.ie/en/_box)

If you have a website, you are welcome to include a searchbox for our dictionaries in it.
[More information...](https://www.teanglann.ie/en/_box)

## [An Foclóirí »](https://www.teanglann.ie/en/_focloiri)

A plugin which makes every word on your website clickable, letting your users look words up while they read.
[More information...](https://www.teanglann.ie/en/_focloiri)
